name: email
description: Universal Multi-Account IMAP & SMTP Email MCP Micro-Daemon with Modern Auth (OAuth 2.0 PKCE / XOAUTH2) and Real-Time IMAP IDLE Push for Syndae Agent OS

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all configured email accounts, their providers, masked addresses, and real-time connection status

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: Fetch a list of recent emails from mailbox with envelope headers, read status, and attachment flags

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Retrieve full email details including complete text body, sender/recipient metadata, and attachment summaries by message UID

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search mailbox for emails matching a keyword across sender, subject, or message body

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Draft and dispatch an outbound email via SMTP. Sensitive action: generates a Human-in-the-Loop approval ticket in Syndae

tools.name: archive_or_mark_email
tools.description: Manage email status: mark read/unread, flag/star, move to folder (e.g. Archive or Trash), or delete
